run_golden_from_imagenet: run the script to generate a golden image dataset from ImageNet using default category set and 500 images per folder
run_golden_pascal: run the script with --category_set pascal to extract Pascal golden categories from ImageNet
run_golden_custom_output: run the script with custom --out_path to save the golden image info JSON to a specified output location
run_golden_limited_images: run the script with --image_per_folder 100 to limit extraction to 100 images per ImageNet class folder
run_golden_subset: run the script with --category_set golden to extract only the core golden categories from ImageNet
